action:
This update uses a new upstream release, which includes additional bug
fixes. After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
Albert Yang and Quang Luong discovered that the Compiler component of CRaC
JDK 17 did not correctly handle certain inputs. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary
code. (CVE-2026-114938)

It was discovered that the JGSS component of CRaC JDK 17 did not correctly
authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read
or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114939)

Nicholas Carlini discovered that the JSSE component of CRaC JDK 17 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114940)

It was discovered that the Libraries component of CRaC JDK 17 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or to read or modify sensitive data.
(CVE-2026-114942)

It was discovered that the Hotspot component of CRaC JDK 17 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114943)

correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114944)
